title: Brahmaputra Mahatmyam: Snana-Tarpana Paddhati and Riverine Toponymy of Ancient Assam
author: Kalish Chandra Barua
description: Exhaustive cultural and religious treatise on the sacred geography, pilgrimage ghats, and riverine chronicles of the Brahmaputra (Nam Dao Phi / Luit) and its major tributaries, including the Buridihing, Dikhow, Disang, and Dhansiri, detailing both Sanskrit and Tai historical associations.
source: Shri Kalish Chandra Barua / Internet Archive (in.ernet.dli.2015.452589)
